about: What `fast-test` runs for a change (see ~/Code/fast-test). The tests run in fast-test's Nix container on The Beast, in the dev shell (tests/fast-test-container), and so does the flake's evaluation; only the linters' quick step runs on The Dragon. The NixOS checks (every flake check, the VM tests, the ISO) stay on the nixos.yml workflow on The Beast's runners: it runs on every push to main, and by hand on a branch.

steps.name: regression
steps.about: The source and fixture regression suite, with the linters (tests/lint: Ruff, ShellCheck, actionlint).

steps.name: shell
steps.about: QML lint and the shell's runtime tests (Settings, Software, Software Update, Welcome, shortcuts, wallpapers, displays, media, plugins), when the code they run changed. Each test's Quickshell has a home, runtime directory, session bus and compositor of its own, so the step runs beside the others and beside another run.

steps.name: assistant-overlay
steps.about: The real Cybex OS Assistant window and service in a private headless Sway, when the assistant changed.

steps.name: single-tests
steps.about: A changed standalone test script, one after the other. Each one's Quickshell has a home, runtime directory, session bus and compositor of its own, so the step runs beside the others and beside another run.
steps.run: tests/fast-test-container sh -c 'for f in "$@"; do python3 -B "$f" || exit 1; done' sh {files}

steps.name: lint
steps.about: The linters, for the workflows and scripts the regression step (which runs them too) skips.

steps.name: flake-check
steps.about: The flake evaluates, in fast-test's Nix container on The Beast (its copy there is one commit deep, so Nix is told that's fine).
